title: South Congress pickup availability
summary: Saturday pickup slots are available at 9:30 AM and 10:15 AM.

title: Downtown pickup availability
summary: Saturday pickup slots are available at 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

title: The Domain pickup availability
summary: Saturday pickup slots are available at 10:00 AM and 10:45 AM.

title: Breakfast Coffee Pack
summary: The Breakfast Coffee Pack serves 18 and includes three regular coffee travelers, cups, condiments, and mini pastries for $88. It covers the group but does not include decaf.

title: Decaf Office Pack
summary: The Decaf Office Pack serves 12 and includes two decaf travelers with cups and condiments for $56. It covers decaf guests but has no regular coffee or pastries.

title: Mixed Meeting Pack
summary: The Mixed Meeting Pack serves 12 and includes one regular traveler, one decaf traveler, cups, condiments, and twelve mini pastries for $74. It is the best fit for a twelve-person mixed-preference meeting.

title: Build Your Own Meeting Order
summary: A build-your-own order with two regular travelers, one decaf traveler, and twelve pastries serves about 18 for $96. It offers extra coffee but costs $22 more than the Mixed Meeting Pack.

title: South Congress late morning pickup availability
summary: Saturday pickup slots at South Congress are also available at 11:30 AM and 12:15 PM.

title: Lamar pickup availability
summary: Saturday pickup slots are available at 9:45 AM and 10:30 AM at Lamar.
